notes: No SEC filings; all figures come from the Tencent Annual Report 2025 as published on HKEXnews (filed 9 April 2026), which reports in RMB (ISO CNY). Ownership is as at 31 December 2025 from the SFO Part XV registers in the Directors' Report, not a proxy record date. Ma Huateng (Chairman and CEO) holds 8.82% through Advance Data Services Limited (wholly owned by him), partly via Ma Huateng Global Foundation Limited; the report lists it as a corporate interest. His share count is unchanged; the percentage rose because buybacks cut the issued shares to 9,120,235,999. MIH Internet Holdings (Prosus/Naspers) fell to 22.80% (2,079,512,000 shares). Buybacks are the cash-flow line 'Payments for repurchase of shares' (RMB 73,312m). This excludes RMB 4,869m of 'Payments for shares purchased/withheld for share award schemes', which buys shares for employee awards rather than returning cash. Dividends exclude RMB 2,372m paid to non-controlling interests. Stock comp is the employee benefits expense line (RMB 31,859m). The geography note now names the region 'Chinese Mainland' (the 2024 report said 'The Mainland of China'). Tencent's www.tencent.com investor pages have refused automated requests before, so HKEXnews was used.
